name: Suffolk city -> Chesapeake district
reason: Suffolk sends 44% of its workers to Chesapeake, Portsmouth, Norfolk and Virginia Beach, 13% to the Peninsula; the greedy joins had put it with the Peninsula through Isle of Wight

name: Isle of Wight County -> Chesapeake district
reason: Western Tidewater stays together (and contiguous) with Suffolk; its workers split between the Peninsula (25%) and the Southside (about 30%)

name: Surry County -> Chesapeake district
reason: Western Tidewater: reaches the rest of Hampton Roads through Isle of Wight

name: Gates County -> Chesapeake district
reason: Western Tidewater: its commuters go to Suffolk (10%) and the Southside cities

name: St. Louis city -> North & Central St. Louis County
reason: 32% of the city's workers go to the North & Central piece and 16% to West & South County (2% to Metro East); without the pin the Metro East counties, which commute into downtown, draw the city into a 1.45M district with the piece

name: Madison County IL -> St. Clair County IL
reason: Metro East forms its own district (0.55M with Monroe) rather than attaching county by county to the city

name: Monroe County IL -> St. Clair County IL
reason: 34% of its workers go to the Metro East and city district, 23% to the Missouri side (jobs inside Monroe excluded)

name: St. Charles -> West & South St. Louis County subregion
reason: Keeps St. Charles with the Missouri suburbs (18% of its workers go to West & South County, which it borders at Chesterfield); by commuting alone the grouping would pair St. Charles with Metro East around the core (70% of commuting kept inside subregions against 63% here), the wrap-around this pin avoids

name: Vieques -> the south (Patillas)
reason: Off the east coast, next to the San Juan metro's Ceiba and Fajardo, which are not in this region; Patillas is the nearest unit of the rest of Puerto Rico (most of Vieques's workers work on the island)

name: Culebra -> the south (Patillas)
reason: With Vieques: the two islands go together

name: Naguabo -> Caguas & Humacao district
reason: Its out-commuters split evenly (D01 2,327, D03 2,308; without San Juan city D03 leads 53-46%); Humacao is its top destination and hospital town, and it shares Humacao's senate district; the move raises work-inside in both districts
